title: Repair drops a spoken line while fixing an unrelated issue

provenance.note: The repair guard was fitted after stored revision pairs included a chapter that lost its only spoken line.

manuscript.quote: "Take it, and do not come back before morning."

diagnosis: Removing the line changes the scene from an exchange into narration even though the repair did not authorize that loss.

test.before:
She set the case down.

"Take it, and do not come back before morning."

He read the label twice and nodded.
test.after:
She set the case down.

He read the label twice and nodded.
